input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Section 10 imposes a symmetric consent requirement with no carve-out permitting Company to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, which would block routine corporate reorganizations and M&A. It also lacks any bar on Contractor assigning to a Company competitor and is silent on change of control, leaving room for Contractor to argue a change of control is a prohibited assignment. No Contractor termination or re-pricing right on change of control exists elsewhere (Section 6 termination rights are unrelated), so the minimal fix is to add the affiliate/successor carve-out, the competitor bar, and an express confirmation that a Company change of control is not an assignment and triggers no Contractor exit or re-pricing right.

proposal.summary: Add Company affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, bar Contractor assignment to our competitors, and confirm change of control is not an assignment or Contractor exit right
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added customary affiliate and transaction successor assignment rights for Company, barred assignment of the Agreement to our competitors, and confirmed that a change of control of Company is not an assignment and gives Contractor no termination or re-pricing right. As a fallback we can accept mutual successor assignment on written notice with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided, however, that Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and Contractor shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Company. No change of control of Company shall be deemed an assignment or give Contractor any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
